items: Map every place guests leave feedback, from Google reviews to surveys and social media, because a tool that watches only one channel gives you a misleading picture.
Define your main use case first, whether that's tracking sentiment trends, closing the loop with guests or benchmarking locations, and filter tools by it.
The most useful insights explain why sentiment moved, which locations drive it and which issues recur, tied to POS, CRM or reservation data.
For multi-location brands, look for cross-location roll-ups, per-site drill-down and role-based access so managers see their store and leadership sees everything.
Momos unifies reviews from every platform, replies with its AI agent Alfie and uses Rockie to rank locations and surface the operational issues behind guest sentiment.
